attachments.origin_landmark: flexor retinaculum and the ulnar border of the palmar aponeurosis
attachments.insertion_landmark: skin of the ulnar border of the palm

innervation.root_levels: C8-T1 (superficial branch of the ulnar nerve)

actions: wrinkles the skin of the hypothenar eminence, deepening the palmar hollow for grip

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: The only muscle in the hand that inserts entirely into skin. It covers Guyon's canal, and its preserved function in an ulnar lesion at the wrist -- the palmaris brevis sign -- helps localise the level of injury.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
